text:
rachel: hi folks — trying the node quickstart (local dev), using a service-account token. first request returns `402 Payment Required`. quickstart didn't warn about suspended billing. any tips?

rachel: curl I used: ```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer SA-DEV-77' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"test"}'
```

rachel: response header: `HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required` body: `{"error":"payment_required","message":"workspace_billing_suspended"}`

devon_devex: thanks — couple quick checks: 1) confirm the SA is in the same org as the workspace, 2) check Console -> Workspace -> Billing for suspended/overdue state, 3) note that if billing was recently fixed the tenant cache may still block calls until refreshed.

rachel: console shows workspace status: "Billing suspended - invoices overdue". I just paid the outstanding invoice via card and hit "Accept billing". billing page now shows "Active".

devon_devex: good. two followups: a) run `@billing-bot refresh <org_id>` from slack to force tenant cache invalidation, b) restart your dev process — the SDK keeps an in-memory tenant mapping and won't pick up a billing state change until re-init in some older SDK versions.

rachel: did `@billing-bot refresh org_5601`. also restarted my local `npm start` server. still 402 though.

billing-bot: queued tenant refresh for org_5601 — cache invalidation scheduled (ETA ~25s).

jorge_ops: another thing — if you minted the SA token before the workspace left suspended state, that token might not be mapped yet. try regenerating the SA key after billing is active, then restart the app.

rachel: regenerated SA key in console and updated RW_KEY env var, restarted process again. retried after ~40s.

rachel: new response: `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` and body contains generated text. first successful call! :tada:

devon_devex: excellent — thanks for the debug steps. follow-ups: 1) quickstart should mention suspended/invoice-overdue states and include the `@billing-bot refresh` step + note about SDK tenant cache, 2) SDK team: consider emitting a clearer error variant for suspended billing (currently comes back as payment_required) and surface `tenantMapped` flag on error to speed debugging, 3) Console: maybe add a one-click "Refresh tenant cache" for workspace owners. filing todos.

rachel: thanks all — happy to paste exact logs if needed, closing this thread. :thumbsup:
